title: MAE 3293 Fundamentals of Aerodynamics: Interactive Lessons
description:
Interactive lessons and calculators for the compressible-flow part of MAE 3293, Fundamentals of Aerodynamics, at Oklahoma State University: compressible flow preliminaries, normal shock waves, oblique shock and expansion waves, and nozzles, diffusers and wind tunnels, with calculators for isentropic flow, normal and oblique shocks, Prandtl–Meyer expansion and supersonic airfoils. Every figure is computed from the compressible-flow relations for a calorically perfect gas, and each page is a single self-contained HTML file that also works offline.

Live site: https://kursatkara.github.io/MAE3293_Fundamentals_of_Aerodynamics/
notes: Code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is released under the MIT License; content (explanatory text, worked solutions, figures and diagrams) under CC BY 4.0. Developed with assistance from ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude.
